name: campus board ladder
description: Moving up a campus board hand over hand without your feet, grabbing each rung while the elbow is still bent. It builds explosive pulling power and the finger strength to latch small holds.
instructions: Campus only when you are an experienced climber, fresh and fully warmed up with easier climbing and hangs.
Hang from the lowest rung with both hands in a half crimp and your feet off the wall.
Pull hard and reach one hand up to a higher rung, for example rung 3.
Grab the rung with your elbow still bent and keep the grip firm.
Pull again and send the other hand past it to a higher rung, for example rung 5, and continue to the top.
Let go in control and land on your feet on a padded floor.
Make it easier with your feet on footholds or shorter gaps, and harder with bigger gaps such as 1-4-7.
